標題： A Discussion on How Africa can Shape New Utopias for the 21st Century
日期： Tue, 4 Mar 2025 15:07:16 +0800

親愛的東華師生們：

誠摯邀請各位師生參與由法國在臺協會、國際事務處、原住民民族學院與藝術學院共同舉辦的學術研討會暨音樂展演。本次活動特別邀請美國杜克大學 Felwine Sarr 特聘教授蒞校，並分享其最新著作。誠摯邀請全校師生踴躍參與，共同感受這場思想與藝術交織的國際盛會！

📅 活動資訊

📖 學術研討會
主題： How Africa Can Shape New Utopias for the 21st Century
日期： 2025/3/10
時間： 14:30-16:30
地點： 藝術學院A104
主持人： 原住民民族學院 石忠山院長
與談人：
族群關係與文化學系  傅可恩教授
藝術創意產業學系  陳怡方主任

🎶 音樂展演與交流
日期： 2025/3/10
時間： 18:00-20:00
地點： 藝術學院A104

📢 活動免費參加，歡迎所有對文化、音樂及國際學術交流有興趣的師生踴躍參加！

報名連結：https://forms.gle/3yQbcBSYd8cAt8WV8

📢 Invitation: International Conference & Music Performance at NDHU

Dear NDHU Faculty and Students,

We are delighted to invite you to an Seminar & Music Performance, jointly organized by the French office in Taipei, Office of International Affairs, College of Indigenous Studies and College of the Arts. This special event will feature Professor Felwine Sarr from Duke University, along with a presentation of his latest book. We warmly welcome all NDHU faculty and students to join us!

📅 Event Details

📖 Seminar
Theme: How Africa Can Shape New Utopias for the 21st Century
Date: March 10, 2025 (Monday)
Time: 14:30-16:30
Venue: College of The Arts, Room A104
Host: Distinguished Professor Chung-Shan Shih, Dean of the College of Indigenous Studies
Discussants:
Professor P. Kerim Friedman, Department of Ethnic Relations and Cultures
Professor Yi-Fang Chen, Chair of the Department of Arts and Creative Industries

🎶 Music Performance & Exchange
Date: March 10, 2025 (Monday)
Time: 18:00-20:00
Venue: College of The Arts, Room A104

📢 This event is free and open to all faculty and students.

Registration Link: https://forms.gle/3yQbcBSYd8cAt8WV8
